en.headline: Chinese Medicine Hospital to launch 24-hour inpatient services on 11 December
en.dek: The Tseung Kwan O facility will open 93 inpatient beds in the first phase, with government-subsidised care priced at a package rate of HK$980 per day.
body: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong will begin 24-hour inpatient services on 11 December, the Health Bureau and the hospital operator announced on Tuesday. It is the first dedicated traditional Chinese medicine hospital in the city to offer round-the-clock inpatient care.

In the first phase the hospital will provide 93 inpatient beds, comprising 60 government-subsidised and 33 market-oriented beds, plus 20 beds under its clinical trial and research centre and two high-dependency beds. Capacity is expected to reach 400 beds by the end of 2030.

Government-subsidised inpatient care will cost a fixed package rate of HK$980 per day, covering accommodation, ward rounds by Chinese and Western medicine practitioners, Chinese medicine treatments, basic laboratory and X-ray diagnostics, therapy and prescribed medications. Eligible patients receiving social welfare assistance may qualify for a full fee waiver. Ten additional special disease programmes will also be introduced by the end of the year.

zh.headline: 香港中醫醫院12月11日起開展24小時住院服務
zh.dek: 將軍澳醫院首階段提供93張住院病床，政府資助服務以每日980元套餐收費，預計2030年底達400張病床。
body: 醫務衞生局與香港中醫醫院營運機構星期二公布，醫院將於12月11日起分階段開展24小時住院服務，成為全港首間提供全日住院照顧的專科中醫醫院。
首階段設有93張住院病床，包括60張政府資助及33張市場導向病床，另有20張臨床試驗及研究中心病床和兩張加護病床。預計至2030年年底醫院將提供共400張病床。
政府資助住院服務以每日980元固定套餐收費，涵蓋住房、中西醫巡房、中醫治療、一般化驗及X光診斷、專職醫療服務及藥物等。合資格綜援受助人可獲全額豁免。醫院亦會於年底前加推十個專病項目。
